title: OT-2 Demo Plating Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Reagents are transferred sequentially from the source labware to the corresponding positions of the destination labware.

steps.title: Configure source labware and pattern
steps.instruction: Select the source labware for the OT‑2 run. If using a 24‑well tube rack, set the robot to transfer each source tube to four destination wells in a row (e.g., tube A1 → wells A1‑D1, tube B1 → wells E1‑H1, tube C1 → wells A2‑D2, etc.). If using a 12‑channel reservoir, set the robot to transfer each reservoir channel to the entire destination column (channel 1 → column 1, channel 2 → column 2, etc.). Reagents are transferred down columns and then across rows as described.

steps.title: Transfer reagents sequentially
steps.instruction: Program the OT‑2 to move reagents from each source position to its corresponding destination wells in the order defined, completing each transfer before starting the next.

steps.title: Set magnetic module height
steps.instruction: If a magnetic module is attached, engage it at a height of 18 mm.
